name: Westfield Century City
description: Westfield Century City is a premier open-air luxury shopping destination in the heart of Los Angeles, featuring over 200 stores and restaurants including flagship department stores Bloomingdale's and Nordstrom. The recently reimagined center combines high-end retail with world-class dining experiences like Eataly, Din Tai Fung, and Katsuya, alongside entertainment options including AMC Theatres. With its modern architecture, abundant natural light, and curated mix of luxury, contemporary, and experiential brands, it serves as a sophisticated lifestyle hub for West LA's affluent community.
demographics: Affluent, upscale demographic in West Los Angeles, including Beverly Hills, Westwood, and surrounding affluent neighborhoods. High-income households with strong purchasing power.
summary: Westfield Century City is an upscale open-air shopping center featuring luxury retail, fine dining, and entertainment in the heart of West Los Angeles.
